## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan Chán Q&A catechism, X67 n1312. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

The text's 100 questions systematically interrogate Wànsōng on the major Chán doctrinal and practical topics. Parallel in form to other Chán catechetical Q&A collections from the period.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1220 (Wànsōng's mature productive period); *notAfter* 1246 (Wànsōng's death).
